runas.efecto: After changing stances, your next offensive ability's rage cost is reduced by 10.
For 15 sec after leaving a stance, you can use abilities requiring that stance as if you were still in that stance.

For the first 15 sec after activating a stance, you can gain an additional benefit: Battle Stance/Gladiator Stance: 5% increased damage done. Berserker Stance: 5% increased critical strike chance. Defensive Stance: 5% reduced Physical damage taken.
Overpower critical strikes refresh the duration of Rend on your target back to its maximum duration.
Your Heroic Strike, Slam, and Overpower abilities deal 10 + (5 * Combo Points)% more damage.
Your Slam hits reset the remaining cooldown on your Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst, and Shield Slam abilities.
Reduces the cooldown on your Death Wish by 50%.
You deal 15% increased damage while any nearby enemy is afflicted with both your Rend and your Deep Wounds.
Increases the block value of your shield by 30.
You gain 1 extra Rage every time you take any damage or deal auto attack damage.
Increases all threat you generate in Defensive Stance by an additional 10% and increases all damage you deal in Gladiator Stance by 4%.
You gain 10 Rage every time you Parry or one of your attacks is Parried.
Revenge also grants you Flurry, increasing your attack speed by 30% for the next 3 swings.
When your target Parries an attack, you instantly Retaliate for 200% weapon damage to that target. Retaliate cannot be Dodged, Blocked, or Parried, but can only occur once every 30 sec per target.
Reduces the cooldown on Thunder Clap by 100%.
Your Shield Slam deals 100% increased threat and its cooldown is reset if it is Dodged, Parried, or Blocked.
Reduces the cooldown on your Shield Slam ability by 2 sec.
Reduces the cooldown on your Bloodrage ability by 30 sec while you are in Gladiator Stance.
Reduces the cooldown on Shockwave by 25%.
Feint also grants Avoidance for 6 sec, reducing all damage taken from area of effect attacks from non-players by 50%.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Poisons by 100%.
Your finishing moves have a 5% chance per combo point to make your next ability cost no energy.
Your opening moves have a 100% chance to make your next ability cost no energy.
Increases damage dealt by your main hand weapon from combo-generating abilities by 20%.
Reduces the cooldown on Vanish to 1 min. Cannot be combined with Elusiveness.
Increases Mutilate and Saber Slash damage by 20%.
Reduces the cooldown on Adrenaline Rush by 4 min.
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers by 5%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 30%.
Your finishing moves cost 50% less Energy.
While Just a Flesh Wound and Blade Dance are active, Crimson Tempest, Blunderbuss, and Fan of Knives cost 20  less Energy and generate 100% increased threat.
Vanish now reduces all Magic damage you take by 50% for its duration, but it no longer grants Stealth or breaks movement impairing effects.
Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to make you take 20% less Physical damage from the next melee attack that hits you within 10 sec.
Your Rolling with the Punches now also activates every time you gain a combo point.
Your Rolling with the Punches also grants you 20% increased Armor from items per stack (capped at 100%).
The cooldown on your Main Gauche resets every time your target Dodges or Parries.

Your Main Gauche now strikes 1 additional nearby target and also causes your Sinister Strike to strike 1 additional nearby target for 10 sec. These additional strikes are not duplicated by Blade Flurry.
While active, your Main Gauche also causes you to heal for 15% of all damage done by Sinister Strike. Any excess healing becomes a Blood Barrier, absorbing damage up to 20% of your maximum health.
Lifetap generates 50% more mana and 100% less threat.
Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.
Your Nightfall talent has a 4% increased chance to trigger. Your Incinerate has a 4% chance to trigger your Decimation regardless of the target's health.
Increases the damage of your periodic spells and Felguard pet by 10 + (5 * Combo Points)%.
Periodic damage from your Shadowflame, Unstable Affliction, and Curse of Agony spells and damage done by your Felguard have a 4% chance to grant the Shadow Trance effect.
Shadowbolt deals 10 + (5 * Combo Points)% increased damage for each of your effects afflicting the target, up to a maximum of 30 + (5 * Combo Points)%.

Reduces the cooldown on your Chaos Bolt by 50% and increases Chaos Bolt and Shadow Bolt damage done by 10%. In addition, Chaos Bolt can now trigger your Improved Shadow Bolt talent and causes it to have 26 additional charges (does not stack with Shadowflame's additional charges).
Each time you hit a target with Conflagrate, you gain 5% increased Fire damage for 20 sec, stacking up to 2 times.
Increases the Attack Power and Spell Damage your Demon pet gains from your attributes by 20%.
Increases the benefits of your Master Demonologist talent by 50%.
Banish is now instant cast, and can be cast on yourself while you are a Demon. You cannot Banish yourself while you have Forbearance, and doing so will give you Forbearance for 1 min.
Each time you take damage, you and your pet gain mana equal to the damage taken, up to a maximum of 420 mana per event. Can only occur once every few seconds.
Your Shadow Cleave hits have a 20% chance to grant you a Soul Shard, reset the cooldown on Soul Fire, and make your next Soul Fire within 10 sec instant.

While you are targeting an enemy within 30 yards, Life Tap grants you mana at the expense of your target's health but deals 50 + (5 * Combo Points)% reduced damage to them. Mana gained remains unchanged.
While Metamorphosis is active, your offensive abilities and Demon summons cost no Soul Shards. In addition, you heal for 15% of your maximum health when you damage a target with Shadowburn.
Any excess healing you deal to yourself  is converted into a shield that absorbs damage. This shield can absorb up to 30 + (5 * Combo Points)% of your maximum health, and stacks from multiple heals.
Reduces the cooldown on your Shadow Cleave by 1.5 sec.

The effects of your Demonic Sacrifice now persist while you have a Demon pet active, as long as you do not resummon the sacrificed pet. You may have only one Demonic Sacrifice effect active at a time.
For 6 sec after using Shadowcleave, your Searing Pain strikes 1 additional target within melee range.
You generate 100% more threat for 8 sec after using Distracting Shot.
While tracking a creature type, you deal 3% increased damage to that creature type.
Your next Shot ability within 12 sec after Aimed Shot deals 20% more damage.
Your Aimed Shot deals 20% more damage to targets afflicted by one of your trap effects.
Your damaging Shot abilities deal 10% increased damage if the previous damaging Shot used was different than the current one.
Your Serpent Sting damage is increased by 25% of your Attack Power over its normal duration.
Increases Kill Shot's damage against non-player controlled targets by 10%.

Kill Shot's cooldown is reduced by 50%.  While Rapid Fire is active with Rapid Killing engraved, Kill Shot has no cooldown, and when used against a non-player controlled target, fires 3 additional Kill Shots at 30% damage, with a minimum range.
Increases the Attack Power your Beast pet gains from your attributes by 20%.
Increases the Focus regeneration of your Beast pet by 20%.
Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100%.
Your Mongoose Bite also reduces its target's chance to Dodge by 1% and increases your chance to hit by 1% for 30 sec.
Mongoose Bite also activates for 5 sec whenever your target Parries or Blocks or when your melee attack misses.
Raptor Strike increases the damage done by your next other melee ability (excluding Wing Clip) within 5 sec by 20%.
Increases damage dealt by your main hand weapon with Raptor Strike and Wyvern Strike by 20%.
Your periodic damage has a 5% chance to reset the cooldown on one of your Strike abilities. The Strike with the longest remaining cooldown is always chosen.
Increases Wyvern Strike damage over time by 50% and increases your pet's maximum focus by 50.
Increases the impact damage of Mongoose Bite and all Strikes by 20%.
-0.1 sec to the casting time of Flash Heal and -0.2 sec to the casting time of Greater Heal.
Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.
Increases your critical strike chance with Prayer of Healing and Circle of Healing by 25%.
Allows 15% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Your periodic healing has a 2% chance to make your next spell with a casting time less than 10 seconds an instant cast spell.
Circle of Healing and Penance also place a heal over time effect on their targets that heals for 25% as much over 15 sec.
Your Prayer of Mending gains 2 additional charges.
Your Circle of Healing now heals the most injured member of the target party for 100% more.
Reduces the cooldown of your Penance spell by 6 sec.
Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield spell by 10%.
You may cast Flash Heal while in Shadowform.
Mind Blast critical strikes reduce the duration of your next Mind Flay by 50% while increasing its total damage by 25%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Shadow Word: Death spell by 6 sec.

Your Shadow Word: Pain has a 2.0% chance per talent point in Spirit Tap to trigger your Spirit Tap talent when it deals damage, or a 20% chance per talent point when a target dies with your Shadow Word: Pain active. Inner Focus also has a 20% chance per talent point to trigger Spirit Tap.
While Spirit Tap is active, you deal 25% more Shadow damage.
Your Mind Flay no longer loses duration from taking damage and launches a free Mind Spike at the target on cast.
Your Mind Spike is now instant, deals 10% more damage, and can be cast while channeling another spell.
Your Pain and Suffering rune can now refresh the duration of Devouring Plague.
Your Temporal Beacons last 20% longer.
Increases all chronomantic healing you deal by 10%.
Each time you heal a target with Regeneration, the remaining cooldown on Rewind Time is reduced by 1 sec.
Your Arcane Missiles refunds 10% of its base mana cost each time it deals damage.
Arcane Blast gains a 10% additional chance to trigger Missile Barrage, and Missile Barrage now affects Regeneration the same way it affects Arcane Missiles.
Your Temporal Beacons caused by Mass Regeneration now last 21 sec.
Your Arcane Blast increases damage done by an additional 10% per stack.
Your Mana Shield, Fire Ward, and Frost Ward absorb 50% more damage and also place a Temporal Beacon on the target for 30 sec.
Increases the chance to trigger your Fingers of Frost rune by an additional 15%.
Increases damage done by your Frostbolt and Spellfrost Bolt spells by 75%.
You are immune to all damage while channeling Evocation.
You gain 1% increased damage for 15 sec each time you cast a spell from a different school of magic.

Mage Armor increases your mana regeneration while casting by an additional 15%. Molten Armor increases your spell damage and healing by 18. Ice Armor grants 20% increased chance to trigger Fingers of Frost.
Decreases the threat generated by your Fire spells by 20%.
Your Pyroblast deals 20% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Fireball's periodic effect.
Your Fireball's periodic effect gains increased damage over its duration equal to 100% of its impact damage.
Your Fire Blast now also causes your next Fire spell to gain 50% increased critical strike chance for 10 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Ignite talent by 10%.
Your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Balefire Bolt spells gain 4% increased damage for each of your Fire effects on your target, up to a maximum increased of 12%.
Increases the block value of your shield by 30.
Heal for 189 to 211 when you Block. Can only heal once every few seconds.
Holy Shield no longer has charges and instead always lasts its full duration. In addition, its damage is increased by 80% of your shield block value.
Increases the bonus chance to Block from Holy Shield by 10%.
You take 10% reduced damage while Holy Shield is active.
Your Reckoning talent now has a 20% chance per talent point to trigger when you Block.
Your Blessing of Sanctuary also grants 10% increase to all stats when cast on yourself.
Shield of the Righteous causes your next Holy Light to be instant cast. If cast on self, it will refund 100% of its mana cost and be unaffected by Guarded by the Light.
Increases the chance for allies to trigger your Judgement of Light or Judgement of Wisdom to 70%.
Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.
Whenever your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Beacon of Light heals a target to full health, you also heal all members of their party for 189 to 211 health.
Increases the critical strike chance of Holy Shock by 5%.
Increases the damage done by your Consecration by 50%.
While you are not your Beacon of Light target, your Beacon of Light target is also healed by 75% of the damage you deal with Consecration, Exorcism, Holy Shock, Holy Wrath, and Hammer of Wrath.
Reduces the cooldown on Divine Light by 25%.
Your heals on your Beacon of Light target also heal the nearest friendly injured target for 90% as much.
Your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom also grant the effects of Judgement of the Crusader.

Your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Martyrdom, and Sunlight deal 35% less damage, but now persist for 6 seconds after you cast another Seal, or until you cast a third Seal. Your Judgements can now trigger multiple Seals if active.
Increases damage done by your damaging Judgements by 5% and your Judgements no longer consume your Seals on the target. Your Judgements can now trigger multiple Seals if active.
Reduces the cooldown on your Judgement ability by 5 sec, but reduces the damage your Judgements deal by 45%.
Your Judgement grants 1% increased Holy damage for 8 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
Increases Crusader Strike damage by 150%.
Your basic attacks with two-handed melee weapons increase the damage of your next Exorcism cast within 20 sec by 35%.  Stacking up to 3 times.
Increases damage done by your Holy Shock spell by 50%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism spell by 3 sec and increases its damage done by 75%.
While a one-handed weapon is equipped, Crusader Strike now unleashes the Judgement effect of your Seals, but does not consume the Seal.
Increases your attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after you parry, dodge, or block.
Your parries and dodges also activate your Shield Mastery rune ability.
Your Stoneskin Totem also reduces Physical damage taken by 5% and your Windwall Totem also reduces Magical damage taken by 5%.
Your Flame Shock also grants 30% increased chance to Block for 5 sec or until you Block an attack.
Each time you Block, your Block amount is increased by 10% of your Spell Damage for 6 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
Each time you Block an attack, you have a 50% chance to trigger your Maelstrom Weapon rune.
Damaging a target with Stormstrike, Lava Burst, or Molten Blast also reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.
When your Spirit of the Alpha is cast on yourself, it also increases your health by 5%, your threat generated by 25%, and all damage you deal by 5%.
The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 40 yd.
After casting your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave, or Riptide spell, gives you a 25% chance to gain Mana equal to 35% of the base cost of the spell.
Your Healing Wave will now jump to additional nearby targets. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 60%, and the spell will jump to up to 2 additional targets.
Your non-periodic damaging and healing critical strikes now have a 100% chance to trigger your Water Shield, but do not consume a charge or trigger its cooldown.
Your Chain Lightning now also heals the target of your most recent Earth Shield for 100% of the damage done.
Increases the healing of Chain Heal and the damage of Chain Lightning by 20%.
Your Riptide increases the amount healed by Chain Heal by an additional 25%.
Reduces the cast time of Chain Heal by 0.5 sec.
Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.
Your Flurry talent grants an additional 10% increase to your attack speed.
Your chance to trigger Static Shock is increased by 12% (6% while dual - wielding).
Increases the main hand damage done by your Stormstrike by 50%.

While Static Shock is engraved, your Lightning Shield now gains a charge each time you hit a target with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, up to a maximum of 9 charges. In addition, while Static Shock is engraved, your Lightning Shield can now deal critical damage.
Increases Stormstrike and Lava Lash damage by 50%. This effect is increased to 100% if using a two-handed weapon.
Your Stormstrike, Lava Lash and Lava Burst critical strikes cause your target to burn for 30% of the damage done over 4 sec.
Your Lightning Bolt critical strikes have a 35% chance to reset the cooldown on Lava Burst and Chain Lightning and make the next Lava Burst or Chain Lightning within 10 sec instant.
Lava Burst now also refreshes the duration of Flame Shock on your target back to 12 sec.
Your spell critical strikes now have a 100% chance trigger your Elemental Focus talent.
Loyal Beta from your Spirit of the Alpha ability now also increases Fire, Frost, and Nature damage by 5 + (5 * Combo Points)%.
While Clearcasting is active, you deal 15 + (5 * Combo Points)% more non-Physical damage.
You have a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Lava Burst, and a 10% increased chance to trigger your Elemental Focus talent.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 60%.
Your Lava Burst damage is increased by a percentage equal to your spell critical strike chance.
Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 10%.
Increases the chance to trigger your Power Surge rune by an additional 5%.
You may cast Rebirth and Innervate while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.
Reduces the cooldown of Enrage by 30 sec and it no longer reduces your armor.
Bear Form and Dire Bear Form increase all threat you generate by an additional 20%, and Cower now removes all your threat against the target but has a 20 sec longer cooldown.
Swipe(Bear) also causes your Maul to hit 1 additional target for the next 6 sec.
Your Mangle(Bear), Swipe(Bear), Maul, and Lacerate abilities gain 5% increased critical strike chance against targets afflicted by your Lacerate.
Your Swipe now spreads your Lacerate from your primary target to other targets it strikes.
Each time you Dodge while in Dire Bear Form, you gain 10% increased damage on your next Mangle or Swipe, stacking up to 5 times.
Reduces the cooldown on Mangle (Bear) by 1.5 sec.
When you cast Innervate on another player, it is also cast on you.
Casting your Healing Touch or Nourish spells gives you a 25% chance to gain Mana equal to 35% of the base cost of the spell.
Reduces the cooldown on Tranquility by 100% and increases its healing by 100%.
Your healing spell critical strikes trigger the Dreamstate effect, granting you 50% of your mana regeneration while casting for 8 sec.
Your non-periodic spell critical strikes reduce the casting time of your next Healing Touch, Regrowth, or Nourish spell by 0.5 sec.
Increases healing from Wild Growth by 10%. In addition, Wild Growth can now be used in Moonkin Form, and its healing is increased by an additional 50% in that form.
Reduces the cooldown of your Rebirth and Innervate spells by 65%.
Your critical heals with Healing Touch, Regrowth, and Nourish instantly heal the target for another 50% of the healing they dealt.
Your Faerie Fire (Feral) also increases the chance for all attacks to hit that target by 1% for 40 sec.
Periodic damage from your Rake and Rip can now be critical strikes.
Your Rip and Ferocious Bite have a 20% chance per combo point spent to refresh the duration of Savage Roar back to its initial value.
Increases the duration of Rake by 3 sec and its periodic damage by 10%.
Your critical strike chance is increased by 15% while Tiger's Fury is active.
Your Shred, Ferocious Bite, and Mangle(Cat) abilities deal 10% increased damage per your Bleed effect on the target, up to a maximum of 20% increase.
Your Shred no longer has a positional requirement, but deals 5% more damage if you are behind the target.
Your Mangle, Shred, and Ferocious Bite critical strikes cause your target to Bleed for 30% of the damage done over the next 4 sec sec.
Damage dealt by Thorns increased by 100% and duration increased by 200%.
Increases your chance to hit with spells and attacks by 3%.
Reduces the cooldown on Starfall by 50%.
Increases the damage done and damage radius of Starfall's stars and Hurricane by 25%.
Your Wrath casts have a 10% chance to summon a stand of 3 Treants to attack your target for 15 sec.
Your Wrath critical strikes have a 50% chance to make your next Starfire deal 10% increased damage, stacking up to 3 times.
Your Nature's Grace talent gains 1 additional charge each time it triggers.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Starfire, Starsurge, and Wrath by 60%.
Reduces the cast time and global cooldown of Starfire by 0.5 sec.
Increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 10%.
Your melee attacks have 5% less chance to be Dodged or Parried.
